name: IRC_JA_SECONDARY_FLOWS
description: Transactional table that stores information regarding the trigger and then submission of a secondary flow.

columns.name: SECONDARY_FLOW_ID
columns.description: Primary key for this table. System generated.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_SUBMISSIONS table. Column provides an association with original job application.

columns.name: AF_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_AF_VERSIONS table. The apply flow version used to submit the secondary flow.

columns.name: ESIGN_DESC_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_DESC_VERSIONS_B table. The esign version used to submit secondary apply flow.

columns.name: STEP_ACTION_USAGE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_LC_ACTION_USAGES_B table. Associate a secondary flow trigger/submission with an action in the candidate selection process.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: ORA_TRIGGERED' for secondary flows triggered but not yet submitted or 'ORA_SUBMITTED' for secondary flows that have been both triggered and submitted.

columns.name: SEC_FLOW_TRIGGER_DATE
columns.description: Stores the timestamp when the secondary flow was triggered. This is one of three columns to track the progress made on the secondary flow.

columns.name: SEC_FLOW_TRIGGERED_BY
columns.description: Stores the name of the recruiter or hiring manager, who triggered the secondary flow. This is one of three columns to track the progress made on the secondary flow.

columns.name: SEC_FLOW_SUBM_DATE
columns.description: Stores the timestamp when the secondary flow was submitted by the candidate. This is one of three columns to track the progress made on the secondary flow.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
